description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1823/49 of 15.08.2013, Rathmalana D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land parcel records, including changes to ownership details, extent measurements, encumbrances, and other land-related particulars. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and involves cadastral maps, land parcels, property boundaries, and title settlements, which directly corresponds to the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
